items.quote: And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand
items.claim: The text says Moses put out his hand, caught the serpent, and it turned back into a rod in his hand.
items.action: caught the serpent, which became a rod

items.quote: That they may believe that the LORD God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee.
items.claim: The text says the rod sign was meant to make the people believe that the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob had appeared to Moses.
items.action: gave a sign to establish belief
items.object: the people's belief in Moses' divine commission

items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail.
items.claim: The text says the LORD told Moses to put out his hand and take the serpent by the tail.
